description:

Here you'll find:
-Practical operations and systems for a life-first business
-Honest stories from my own journey (the wilderness seasons included)

title: Psychosexual

description:
Psychosexual is a queer conversation about the things we’re all thinking about and probably should have talked about sooner. Hosted by therapist Brian Kennedy, LPC, and a Jada Pinkett Fox, a trans femme drag entertainer from Dallas, the show dives headfirst into the queer zeitgeist: sex, relationships, polyamory, cruising, kink, dating, masculinity/femininity, body image, loneliness, friendship, living with HIV, nightlife, and all the beautifully complicated ways we try to connect with each other.
It’s funny. It’s sometimes filthy. There’s plenty of shade. But underneath the jokes are real conversations about the psychology of being queer today: why we love the way we love, why we sabotage the things we want, and what happens when the coping mechanisms that once saved us stop working.
Each episode mixes cultural commentary, personal storytelling, listener confessions, outrageous scenarios, and honest conversations about the issues shaping queer lives right now. No judgment. No moralizing. No pretending we have it all figured out. Just two queer people asking the questions, telling the stories, and occasionally calling bullshit.

title: Episode 26.83 Transgender Medicalization
author: Dr. Diana Sorrentino, Ph.D.
description:
Paradoxes of Gender – Episode 26.83:  

Today’s Podcast: Paradoxes of Gender Episode 26.83
Transgender & Gender Diverse Medicalization, with a Focus on the Care & Treatment of Senior & Elder Individuals  

Episode 26.84 Exploring the Issues & Challenges Facing Gender & Sexual Minority Individuals.  

Paradoxes of Gender Podcasts: The Paradoxes of Gender Podcasts are Designed to Deliver Professional Development Educational Programs for the LGBTQ+ Medical & Behavioral Healthcare Providers who provide Medical & Behavioral Healthcare Services to Transgender, Gender Diverse, Gender Non-Conforming, Gender Incongruent and Non-Binary Individuals.  

Prepared & Presented by: Dr. Diana Sorrentino, Ph.D.
Social-Psychologist & Behavioral Analyst  

Delivering comprehensive Medical or Behavioral Healthcare Services as a component of your practice on behalf of Transgender (TG), Gender Diverse (GD) Individuals and members of the LGBTQ+ Community may at times prove to be a little challenging. The challenges you may experience have historically been caused by a lack of specialized medical or behavioral health training you received in preparation for your career and the care you will be providing for Transgender and Gender Diverse patients.    This understanding was underscored and reinforced by a 2011 study, reported in the Journal of the American Medical Association, the medical schools, on average, only provide Five (5) hours of academic or clinical instruction on LGBTQ+ healthcare requirements.  In the absence of specialized training; time is required to acquire first-hand real-world knowledge and experience with the diverse challenges, needs and experiences these individuals present and what they are confronted with as they live their lives in their Self-Attributed Non-Conforming Gender roles.  

Transgender, Gender Diverse, Gender Non-Conforming, Gender Incongruent & Non-Binary individuals, their families, friends, schools, employers and social-networks will also benefit from the content of these Podcasts in-spite of the fact that the detailed medical and psychological content of these programs focuses on the continuing educational needs and requirements of the medical or behavioral healthcare professional.  Knowledge is essential to counteract the negative publicity and the political hyperbole disseminated by individuals with no understanding of the history and underlying biological factors influencing gender non-conformity.    

Dr. Sorrentino is a Member of:
the World Professional Association for Transgender Health

author: June Jones
description:
Hi! I'm June,

The host of Harlot Hotline with June Jones ★


You might know me as the founder of Harlot - stripper-owned, Melbourne-made, built from the club era I never really left. But this podcast isn't about the brand. It's about everything underneath it. I used to be a $tripper. Now I'm a mother, a business owner, and apparently still "too much" for some people - which is exactly why this show exists.


Are you a Harlot? Society's been asking women that question for centuries, usually as an insult. I got sick of it being one. Harlot Hotline is a place for real conversations - with sex workers, advocates, artists, and creatives who've all been told at some point they don't fit in. No filter. No apology. It's part advocacy, part culture, part my own life laid out plainly - the stripper years, what came after, motherhood, business, all of it.


If you've got a guest suggestion, a topic you want covered, or you just want to say hi, email hello@harlothotline.com


I hope you enjoy listening as much as I enjoy making it

title: A Call To Readiness

description:
The modern gospel asks a man to trust what Christ did by His death on the cross for his salvation as opposed to his own works, but stops there, leaving him exactly as he was. Scripture says otherwise: if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature; old things are passed away, behold, all things are become new. This is believed in theory while leaving no evidence in reality, leaving many deceived about the validity of their salvation.
Gerry G. Register preaches the gospel as the power of God unto salvation, and explains what that power is for and what it does in us. Salvation is God's work from first to last. He takes out the heart of stone and gives a heart of flesh. He works in the believer both to will and to do of His good pleasure. God has made Christ unto us wisdom, righteousness, sanctification and redemption.
The faith God gives is not intellectual assent. It is effectual. It changes a man, and remains in us a powerful principle and force that motivates us to action toward God's will.
God has not changed. He is holy, He does not wink at sin, and His expectation is still righteousness. But the gospel of our day treats sincere assent as sufficient and holds out the transformed life as an optional "deeper life" for the especially committed, rather than the ordinary evidence of conversion. So a man may keep his secret sins and believe himself saved. This "deeper life" is never accomplished by the unregenerate. Man's enmity toward God prevents it.
These sermons are Holy Spirit led and grounded in the Scriptures alone. New messages added as they are preached.

The Not So Wild Summer is a 12-week limited series podcast for Christian moms who are done simply surviving summer break and are ready to actually enjoy it — shenanigans and all.

If you are craving an intentional summer routine but feel overwhelmed by the chaos — you just found your tribe! Host Latasha Kennedy — wife, mom of two, business strategist, and multifaceted entrepreneur — knows firsthand what it's like to juggle it all. She's been there: staring into an empty refrigerator at noon, negotiating with kids who suddenly forgot how to read, and trying to hold onto a vision of a summer that feels fun, enjoyable, and dare we say — peaceful.

Think less rigid lecture and more like a text message from your smartest girlfriend who has actually been in the trenches.

What We're Covering This Summer:

Every Tuesday from June through August, Latasha drops a quick 15-minute episode packed with honest, faith-rooted, and highly practical conversation. We are diving into the exact mom life hacks and family systems you need to thrive:

*Summer Routines & Kids' Schedules — How to build a flexible daily rhythm that keeps the peace without killing the fun.

*Mom Self-Care & Sanity — Reclaiming your time, managing burnout, and avoiding the trap of losing yourself in motherhood.

*Family Rhythms & Faith — Practical ways to integrate intentional parenting and faith into your everyday summer chaos.

*Sleep Schedules & Screen Time — Navigating the shifting rules of summer without losing control of the household.

*Back-to-School Transitions — Prepping your mind, home, and kids for a smooth shift back into the school year.

And so much more packed into 12 episodes. 15 minutes. The whole summer winning against these kids' shenanigans — together!

New episodes drop every Tuesday starting June 16th. Hit Follow right now so you never miss a single drop!

title: History Was Human
author: Brian R. Smith
description:
History is usually remembered through wars, revolutions, movements, dates, and famous events. But history did not experience any of those things.


People did.


History Was Human tells the true stories of remarkable people who lived inside the history we now read about—some famous, some forgotten, some misunderstood, and some whose extraordinary lives never received the attention they deserved.


Author Brian R. Smith explores one life at a time, following the historical record beyond the familiar version of events to discover the person behind the name: what they wanted, what they endured, the choices they made, and how the world around them shaped what happened next.


The stories cross cultures, continents, and centuries. Warriors and spies. Rebels and survivors. Leaders, outsiders, and ordinary people caught in extraordinary moments.


Some of these lives have inspired Brian’s historical novels. Others are simply stories too compelling to leave buried in the past.


Because before history became history, it was human.

Your mouth might be the missing piece. Chronic fatigue, stubborn inflammation, mystery symptoms that no one can explain: what if part of the answer has been sitting in your dental chair all along?

Each episode starts with a mystery, follows the clues through real research, and ends with clear steps you can actually take. We cover the topics conventional dentistry rarely talks about: root canals, hidden jaw infections, mercury fillings, metal vs. ceramic implants, gum disease, airway and kids' jaw development, and how to prepare your body before and after dental work.


This is the show for patients who ask questions. No sales pitches, no jargon walls, just the science, the debates, and the stories that make you think, "Wait, could this be me?"


Brought to you by OraBiologics. Ready to find a vetted biologic dentist near you? Download the OraBiologics app.


This podcast is for educational purposes only and is not medical or dental advice. Always talk with a qualified provider about your own health.

title: El rebaño
author: Gregory  Archer
description:
¿Alguna vez has querido tener huevos frescos en tu propio patio, pero no sabías ni por dónde empezar?
The Flock es tu guía completa, semana a semana, para criar gallinas (y con el tiempo patos, pavos, codornices y gansos) en casa. Presentado por el Dr. Gregory Archer y producido por Texas A&M AgriLife Extension: la misma fuente confiable a la que generaciones de agricultores y familias autosuficientes han recurrido en busca de orientación agrícola respaldada por la investigación.
La mayoría de los consejos sobre aves de traspatio que se encuentran en internet están dispersos: una publicación en un foro por aquí, un video de cinco minutos por allá, sin que nada se construya sobre lo anterior. The Flock es diferente. A lo largo de tres años completos —156 episodios semanales— te llevamos desde el "¿realmente debería hacer esto?" hasta manejar con confianza una parvada madura y próspera, cubriendo cada estación, cada desafío y cada logro del camino.
Por qué los oyentes se quedan con este programa:
Es verdaderamente secuencial, no solo una lista de temas. El episodio 1 se pregunta si la crianza de aves de traspatio es adecuada para ti. Para el episodio 52, ya habrás construido un gallinero, sobrevivido a un invierno, recogido tus primeros huevos y aprendido a interpretar el lenguaje corporal de tu parvada. Para el tercer año, estarás manejando un programa de reproducción y quizá hasta un pequeño negocio de huevos. Cada episodio se apoya en el anterior, pero también puedes entrar en cualquier punto y obtener un valor real por sí solo.
Está construido sobre experiencia real, no sobre consejos reciclados de internet. Como parte de Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, este programa se nutre de décadas de investigación agrícola y de ciencia avícola práctica, no de la experiencia personal de un aficionado presentada como verdad universal.
Respeta tu tiempo. Cada episodio dura de 10 a 15 minutos: lo suficiente para enseñarte algo de verdad, lo bastante breve para terminarlo con el café de la mañana o camino al trabajo.
No endulza las partes difíciles. Hablamos con honestidad sobre las pérdidas por depredadores, el costo real de comenzar y el peso emocional de las decisiones duras, porque quienes entran con los ojos bien abiertos son los que se quedan en este gratificante pasatiempo a largo plazo.
Lo que realmente vas a aprender:
El primer año te lleva por los fundamentos: cómo navegar las leyes locales y las reglas de tu asociación de vecinos antes de comprar un solo pollito, elegir razas adecuadas para tu clima y tus objetivos, construir un gallinero a prueba de depredadores, criar pollitos de forma segura en la criadora y manejar tu parvada durante un ciclo completo de estaciones, incluido ese primer huevo tan emocionante.
El segundo año profundiza: incubar tus propios pollitos, sumar nuevas especies a tu patio, enfrentar con confianza problemas reales de salud y explorar si un pequeño negocio de huevos podría ser para ti.
El tercer año es donde todo se une: programas de reproducción intencionales, verdadera autosuficiencia, salud avanzada de la parvada y la construcción de algo que podría convertirse en un auténtico legado familiar, o incluso en una pequeña granja comercial.
Para quién es este programa:
Para principiantes absolutos que nunca han sostenido una gallina, pero sienten curiosidad por saber de dónde viene su comida. Para criadores con experiencia que buscan llenar vacíos reales en sus conocimientos. Para cualquiera atraído por una forma de vivir más autosuficiente y conectada. Y sí, también para quien simplemente se encanta con la idea de un patio lleno de personalidades curiosas y cacareantes.
Ya sea que estés parado en el pasillo de la tienda agrícola preguntándote qué pollitos elegir, que lleves tres años criando y tengas hambre de temas avanzados, o que solo sientas curiosidad y no sepas por dónde empezar, The Flock te encuentra justo donde estás y camina contigo, un episodio práctico a la vez.
Nuevos episodios cada semana. Suscríbete ahora y comienza tu camino con el primer episodio, o salta directo al desafío que estés enfrentando hoy.

Deep Calls Unto Deep is a faith-centered podcast with minister, author, and life coach Bernice Taliaferro.
Through biblical teaching, personal testimony, prayer, and honest conversation, Bernice helps listeners awaken to who God formed them to be, align with His purpose, and activate their calling.
Each episode is an invitation to go deeper—to examine what shaped you, release false identities, recognize God in the ordinary moments of life, and move forward with greater clarity, courage, and faith.
“Before you can become who God called you to be, you must release who life told you to be.”

title: The Turret: The Traitors Fan Podcast
author: Footwork Media
description: The show by fans of The Traitors, for fans of The Traitors. We're here for you after every single show to break down the backstabbing, betrayals, and beguiling schemes. So trim your fringe, and join host Calum Macdonald, Sam Ramsden from The Traitors HQ, and a bunch of guests and former players.

title: Sports & Student Loans Podcast
author: Sports & Student Loans Podcast
description:
Welcome to Sports & Student Loans 🎙️🏈⚾🏀
Just two broke college dumbasses trying to make sense of sports, school, and the financial decisions that will haunt us for the next 20 years. 💸🎓
Meet Josh 💻 — Computer Science major, sports fanatic, and professional overthinker.
And Krew 📊 — Statistics major, sports fanatic, and completely convinced that numbers can explain everything.
Together, we talk football, baseball, basketball, college sports, hot takes, bad takes, and everything in between. 🗣️🔥
No professional analysts.
No insider information.
Just two college kids with microphones

title: Believe
author: ariyan hossain rafe
description: Islam is a religion based on the belief in one God, referred to as Allah in Arabic.Muslims believe that God is the creator and maintainer of the universe, and that He is both merciful and fair.They also believe that people are responsible for their actions and will be judged by God. The Quran is the main religious text of Islam, regarded by Muslims as the direct word of God, revealed to the Prophet Muhammad through the angel Gabriel. It offers teachings on faith, worship, ethics, justice, family life, charity, and the duties people have towards each other. Muslims often explain the basic beliefs of their faith through the Six Articles of Faith. These include belief in one God, His angels, His holy books, His prophets and messengers, the Day of Judgment, and the concept of divine will. Islam also highlights five important acts of worship known as the Five Pillars. These are: declaring faith in one God and in Muhammad as His final messenger, praying five times a day, giving charity to those in need, fasting during the month of Ramadan, and making a pilgrimage to Makkah if possible. At its core, Islam teaches people to worship God, be kind, honest, just, patient, thankful, and to care for others. It also reminds believers that life on Earth is fleeting and that everyone will eventually return to God.

title: Doesn't Matter
author: 86 Films
description: Two-time Peabody Award–winning comedian Hasan Minhaj talks with politicians, public figures, and experts from finance to psychology to astrophysics. In a media culture dominated by certainty, Hasan leads with curiosity, doubt, and a commitment to keep his guests laughing no matter how dark the subject matter. The result is that no matter the personality or topic, we all learn something we didn’t know.

title: NMC Amplifier
author: National Music Centre
description: Hosted by Andrew Mosker, President and CEO of the National Music Centre, NMC Amplifier seeks to move the needle forward on issues in music through shared ideas. Touching on topics such as community building, advocacy, storytelling, placemaking, economic, social and environmental development, education and music's capacity to heal and bring people closer together. Guests include artists, entrepreneurs, innovators, music therapists, healers, authors, and thought-leaders – music champions who are in the spotlight or behind-the-scenes.

title: The Last Lecture with Dr James Mahon
author: James Mahon
description: The podcast for those who have lost their job or are at risk in the UK's HE and FE sector, a series that offers support, insights and guidance to help cope with the challenges with colleges and universities in turmoil.

title: Bless, Bible, and The Bronx
author: Barbie Rodriguez
description: Welcome to Bless, Bible & Bronx, where faith meets real life. I’m Barbie Rodriguez, a Bronx-raised Christian storyteller sharing honest conversations about faith, second chances, cancer, family, and the experiences that shaped me. No perfection and no pretending—just real stories, a little Bronx, and a whole lot of faith. Through it all, my message is simple: Christ loves you, Christ wants you, and it’s never too late to come home to Him.

title: The Keystone Horror Podcast
author: The Keystone Horror Podcast
description:
The Keystone Horror Podcast is dedicated to delivering original stories that explore the strange and unusual. I don't write gory stories for shock value or horror written just to disturb.
Most episodes are standalone, allowing you to enjoy them in any order, while others unfold across multiple parts and are clearly marked. Every story is written, narrated, and produced by me. I have no professional training or education specific to writing or producing. No cheap AI writing or third party stories you've heard hundreds of times before. Just an average guy trying to get his stories into the world.
Thank you for listening and supporting independent horror storytelling.
The Keystone Horror Podcast

title: Changed
author: Change The game Media
description:
CHANGED is an intimate conversation series that goes beyond what people have accomplished to uncover what those experiences did to them. Through honest conversations with influential voices across sports, music, entertainment, business and culture, CHANGED explores the moments, choices, successes and setbacks that shaped who they became. You may know their name. You may know their story. But what happened is only half of it.


CHANGED — Find the Change.

A CTG Media Original.

title: Voices Note to Your Soul
author: Victoria
description:
At the heart of my self-leadership mentoring is meeting my clients in the thick of real life. I often send voice notes when something is happening. A wobble, a win or an old pattern. I offer guidance while they’re in it, so they can see differently and put what they’ve learned into practice. 
And I thought: what if these voice notes could help you too?
Each episode takes something real you might be experiencing and shines a light on it. Not with another quick fix, but by helping you come back to yourself, your intuition and the love and wisdom of your soul.

title: Baweja Multispeciality Hospital
author: bmh Chandigarh
description: BMH Chandigarh is a trusted multispecialty healthcare provider offering comprehensive medical care with experienced doctors, modern facilities, and patient-focused services. Our specialties include ophthalmology, cataract and glaucoma care, dermatology and cosmetic treatments, psychiatry, and gynaecology. We focus on accurate diagnosis, personalized treatment, and compassionate care to support the health and well-being of individuals and families across Chandigarh and nearby areas.

title: Sold in San San Antonio
author: Jerry Robertson
description: Jerry Robertson of SATX Select Estate Sales has personally managed over 300 estate sales. On this show, he breaks down what really happens behind the scenes — from pricing and staging to what happens when items don't sell. Real talk for anyone facing an estate sale, downsizing, or settling a loved one's home in San Antonio and the surrounding areas.

title: Nervous System Recalibration Podcast
author: Tanja
description:
Welcome to Nervous System Recalibration - the show where manifestation finally starts working, because we go straight to the source: your body.

You already know how to visualize. You already know the affirmations. Here, we go deeper - training your nervous system to actually hold the money, the career, the love and the life you're calling in.

title: Behind the Playbook: How Financial Brands Win
author: OpenBrand
description: Behind the Playbook: How Financial Brands Win is a podcast for the leaders shaping the future of financial services. Each episode features intimate conversations with senior executives and industry thought leaders, unpacking the strategy behind how financial brands compete, grow, and earn share of wallet.

title: Journey 2 Love Eve
author: Chrystal and Lisa
description: Round table talks about life’s journey through personal experiences. Speaking intentionally about the many facets of womanhood. Traveling back to the beginning, a time and place of innocence. Reflecting on who we were before we were told to be something else. Let’s talk!

title: The Leila Hormozi’s Podcast
author: Leila Hormozi
description:
Hi! I’m Leila Hormozi, founder of Acquisition.com, where we help ambitious people scale extraordinary companies.

I’ve built and sold 3 businesses (Service, physical product, and SaaS), reached a net worth of over $100M by the age of 28, and learned a lot about entrepreneurship in a short time.

I started this channel because I wanted to help make REAL business education accessible to anyone, no holding back because I have some 'course' to sell you.

I believe education should be accessible to anyone, no matter their background, location, or financial standing. My hope is that by putting out this information,

I can save you some of the pain I had to experience to get the success I have today.

title: Sthitaprajna - The Battlefield Within
author: Vikkas Rana
description:
Every war has a battlefield, but the one that decides everything happens inside the mind.

Sthitaprajna - The Battlefield Within is a sloka-by-sloka journey through the Bhagavad Gita, in the original Sanskrit, starting from the very first verse. Each episode takes the text seriously - not summarized, not skimmed - and asks what it actually means for the battles most people are already fighting: desire, anger, greed, delusion, and the conditioned patterns that keep pulling us back into the same fights.

This isn't a philosophy lecture. It's an attempt to connect an ancient war to the ones going on right now - toxic relationships, toxic workplaces, habits and thoughts that won't let go, and the slow work of becoming someone who doesn't break under pressure. Along the way, the show also asks a bigger question the Gita itself keeps returning to: what does it look like to rise above purely selfish action, and contribute to the welfare of the people, animals, and world we actually share?

The show takes its name from a passage late in Chapter 2 - the description of a Sthitaprajna, a person of steady wisdom, someone grief doesn't move and fear doesn't shake. That's the destination. Getting there, verse by verse, is the whole journey.

title: Lilith's Love
author: Dan Shaurette on Podiobooks.com
description:
Donovan, lonely and getting over the recent death of his parents, asks his long-time friend Christian to move in with him when he relocates back home again to Phoenix from Los Angeles.

After the Vampire Hunters find Lilith in New Orleans, she and her Wiccan friend Anna decide to go where they think no one would expect to find vampires — The Valley of the Sun, Phoenix, AZ.

Christian, who is also a Wiccan, meets Anna at a Samhain event (Halloween). The chemistry between them is immediate, and when they introduce their roommates to each other, Don realizes Lilith is not only the woman of his dreams — but that she is the woman in his dreams at night.

Two romances are sparked, and now that both couples have found each other, they must fight the vengeful plans of Lilith's Master.

title: Rooted Mama Sowing Seeds of Faith Podcast
author: Tina- Rooted Mama Sowing Seeds of Faith
description:
Rooted Mama: Sowing Seeds of Faith is a Christ-centered podcast for women who are ready to grow deeper roots in God while navigating the beautiful, messy, and sometimes painful seasons of life.

Here, we talk about real faith in real life—motherhood, healing, relationships, heartbreak, purpose, homeschooling, homesteading, ministry, and learning to trust God even when we don't understand what He's doing.

Through Scripture, personal testimony, honest conversations, prayer, and encouragement, we'll sow seeds of faith together and allow God to cultivate them into something beautiful.

You don't have to have it all figured out to be used by God. Sometimes the strongest roots grow through the hardest storms.

🌱 Get rooted in His Word.
🌻 Sow seeds of faith.
🤎 Grow where God has planted you.

Welcome to Rooted Mama: Sowing Seeds of Faith—where faith is planted, truth is spoken, and women are encouraged to grow boldly in the purpose God has for them.

title: Good Gossip
author: Taya Alexander
description: Good Gossip is a weekly podcast where host Taya Alexander tells her guests the good things people say about them behind their backs. Each episode, she brings a guest something she's heard said about them (an idea, a compliment, a piece of advice, or a story), and from there we talk about what it really takes to communicate better and build deeper, more intentional relationships. Talking about people behind their backs. Only the good stuff, said to their face. 20 to 30 minutes, every week. Join us @goodgossip.podcast

title: The Tailgate Podcast
author: Joshua Lippert & Theo Manela
description: Weekly in-depth analysis on your favorite teams and news surrounding the NFL.

title: Our Autism Story
author: Paul Robinson
description:
Our Autism Story is a candid, heartfelt podcast exploring the authentic, unvarnished experiences of families raising children with autism. Hosted by Paul Robinson - founder of Sunny Disability Care and father to Thomas, who lives with level 3 autism and requires full-time care - this show delves into the profound joys, daily struggles, and everything in between.
Through intimate conversations with parents, siblings, and extended family members, Paul and his guests share powerful stories of resilience, connection, and hope as they bridge the gap for the wider community.

title: Kat for Christ
author: Katherine LaRocco
description:
Welcome to Kat for Christ. ✝️
Let’s talk about Jesus without pretending we have it all figured out.
This space is for honest conversations about faith, the Bible, doubt, identity, relationships, sin, grace, religious culture, and all the things Christians sometimes feel like we’re not allowed to talk about.
I’m not here to tell you I have all the answers. I’m here to open the Bible, ask the hard questions, challenge what we’ve been taught, and keep coming back to Jesus.
 Real life, real questions, and a real relationship with Christ.
Grab your caffeine. Grab your Bible 
Let’s talk Jesus

title: Catch Me While I Care
author: Sol
description:
Catch Me While I Care is where I talk about whatever I care about… while I still care. 😂 Relationships, motherhood, money, work, healing, boundaries, self-love, pop culture, and all the random life shit in between. Some weeks we’re getting deep, some weeks we’re being messy, and some weeks I just have something to say.
No pretending I have it all figured out—just real conversations, real life, and the lessons I’m learning along the way.
Catch me while I care, because once I don’t… there’s nothing left to talk about. 🎙️💗

title: Social Determinants of Health in Cancer Care
author: American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)
description: ASCO presents Social Determinants of Health in Cancer Care, a podcast series in which oncologists, patients, advocates, and other thought leaders in health equity, turn a spotlight on actionable methods to provide equitable access to cancer care despite nonbiological factors.

title: The Wrestling Delorean Podcast
author: Mike Dinero
description: Hop in the passenger seat and fire up the flux capacitor! The Wrestling Delorean Podcast is your ultimate destination for everything professional wrestling. Hosted by Mike Dinero, this show bridges the gap between the golden eras of the past and the explosive landscape of today’s industry. Whether you’re a fan of the high-stakes drama in AEW, the global spectacle of WWE, or the gritty storytelling of the indies, Mike covers it all with a unique "Then, Now, and Forever" perspective.Each week, we take a trip through the history books to revisit classic matches and forgotten legends, while keeping a firm grip on the current wrestling news, rumors, and pay-per-view reviews. From breaking down the latest AEW Dynamite and WWE SmackDown highlights to predicting the future stars of the business, The Wrestling Delorean is built for the fans who live and breathe the squared circle.Why Ride With Us?Deep Dives: Nostalgic look-backs at the events that shaped your childhood.Expert Analysis: Unfiltered takes on the current state of pro wrestling.Passenger Interaction: Join the conversation and help steer the trajectory of the show.

title: Underground Lucha Experience
author: Bob and Jon
description: Bob and Jon from the Indy Wrestling Experience watch every episode of Lucha Underground from beginning to end.

title: Statecraft with Avi Jorisch
author: Avi Jorisch
description:
Conversations with the people shaping the destiny of Israel and the Jewish people.

Most conversations about Israel happen in public, where every word is measured, or in private, where the real arguments happen. Statecraft lives in between.

Each episode, Jorisch sits down with people who have been inside the room: prime ministers and diplomats, intelligence officials and military commanders, policy architects, entrepreneurs, religious leaders, and dissidents shaping the future of Israel and the Jewish people. These aren't conversations built around titles or talking points. They're built to find the person behind the position: what they knew before the announcement, what frightened them, what it cost them to decide.

At one of the most consequential moments in Israel's history, Statecraft is where the people shaping what comes next talk. Not from a podium, but across the table.


An IEF Production
www.IEF.network

title: Nintendo North Wales' Official Podcast
author: Nintendo North Wales
description: Join us for a discussion on the most recent event, memories of old, and our most anticipated or favourite games of the moment! Guests featuring various current members of Nintendo North Wales!

title: What Kept You Won’t Keep You
author: @WhatKeptYouWontKeepYou | Joshua Berghaus
description: What Kept You Won’t Keep You is a podcast for founders, executives, and leaders who suspect the patterns behind their success are now limiting their leadership, relationships, or future. Hosted by Joshua Berghaus, each conversation examines the instincts, identities, and decisions beneath performance, then turns practical wisdom into action at work and at home. Follow the show for the next episode.

title: Downtime with Decolonial Thoughts
author: Decolonial Thoughts
description: Downtime with Decolonial Thoughts, hosted by Toluse and Theo, is a platform for marginalised experiences and perspectives and for exploring new possibilities. In the words of bell hooks, we have discussions challenging Western "Imperialist white supremacist capitalist patriarchy". We do not try to provide all the answers but aim to foster open conversations and inspire alternative ways of thinking, believing that systemic change begins within our minds.

title: Momentum Management
author: Carlos Raskin
description: Welcome to Momentum Management, the podcast where leadership, strategy, and continuous growth come together. Each episode explores the principles, tools, and real-world insights that help managers, entrepreneurs, and professionals build momentum in their careers, teams, and organizations.From effective leadership and decision-making to productivity, innovation, and business growth, we break down the concepts that drive long-term success. Whether you're leading a company, managing a team, or striving to become a better professional, Momentum Management delivers practical advice and actionable strategies to help you stay focused, overcome challenges, and keep moving forward.Tune in and discover how great leaders create momentum—and how you can do the same.

title: Cosmic Earth Podcast
author: Cosmic Earth Podcast
description: Welcome to the Cosmic Earth Podcast. A place to come home to the remembering of your soul. A soft spot to feel expanded and grounded. This is the new Earth energy — the blend of the wisdom from the cosmos with the rootedness in the Earth. Come have a cup of tea with your new witchy besties, Molly and Greer :)

title: Last Known Tape
author: LKT_Podcast
description:
Welcome to the Last Known Tape Podcast!

Every week, we'll dissect a new found footage horror film. We'll break it down, give it a summary, add trivia, share reviews and overall indulge in found footage follies.

Follow me at: lkt_podcast on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube.

Or, if you'd like to be a part of the fun, email me at: lastknowntapepod@gmail.com

https://lktpodcast.podbean.com/

Now, let's roll that tape!

author: Shereece Stoby
description:
Conversations • Growth • Real life 🌍

📍Guyana

↓ Join the conversation.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Imperfect People Show
author: Imperfect People
description: The Imperfect People Show🎙️ | The Podcast for Honest Conversations on Life, Relationships & Growth  Imperfect People is a weekly podcast exploring life, relationships, fatherhood, mental health, and personal growth through honest, unfiltered conversation. Hosted by Bok and Sech, two friends who bring real perspective, sharp debate, and zero polish to every episode — because growth doesn’t happen in a script.  Some episodes are deep. Some are ridiculous. All of them are real. That’s the standard here: no performance, no pretending — just Imperfect People working through life the same way everyone else is, out loud and on record.

title: The Odlest Trick In The Book
author: Kyle and Chris Odle
description: A teen and his dad sit down and talk about what they're currently interested in through in depth conversations. The goal is to see the world through different lenses and bridge the gap between generations that have grown in vastly different worlds. Weekly episodes posted every Friday.

title: The FootyVault Podcast
author: FootyVaultHQ
description:
FootyVaultHQ — football stories, insights, analysis, and real culture.
Premier League. Champions League. International Football. Nigeria. We cover it all — from the biggest matchday fixtures to the transfer news nobody is talking about yet.
Expect:
— A football podcast full of match previews, reviews & heated debate
— Reactions to the biggest games
— Player profiles of wunderkinds, hidden gems & next gen stars
— Interviews with ex-pros & current players
— And football predictions/weekly tips
Subscribe. New episodes every week.

title: How To Do Business
author: Jackson Johsep
description: Welcome to How To Do Business — your go-to space for insights, strategies, and real-world stories from the world of business and entrepreneurship. Whether you're a startup founder, small business owner, or just curious about how successful ventures are built, this podcast delivers practical knowledge to help you move forward. Join Jackson as he explores market trends, leadership tips, and interviews with inspiring professionals who are making an impact in today’s business landscape.

title: Blood and Mint Tea: True Crime From Morocco
author: Karima & Zack
description:
Storytelling is Morocco's oldest art form. Welcome to the dark side of that tradition.


Blood and Mint Tea is a true crime podcast from Marrakech, telling Morocco's serial killer, murder, and con artist cases in English for the first time. Every episode is one case, start to finish, pulled from the original Arabic and French sources by two people who live where they happened.

These are the stories behind the medina walls.

title: ENGAGED With The League
author: The Pennsylvania Municipal League
description: ENGAGED With The League is a podcast of the Pennsylvania Municipal League, featuring conversations about the challenges and opportunities facing local government. Join us as we talk with leaders, experts and innovators who share ideas and insights to help you thrive in your role.

title: Old Friends and Bad Takes
author: Old Friends and Bad Takes Podcast
description:
*Old Friends and Bad Takes* is a spoiler-filled fantasy-book podcast hosted by longtime friends Adam and Miguel. Each episode tackles part of a fantasy series—one floor, kingdom, battle, and terrible decision at a time—as they recap what happened and debate the characters, choices, theories, and moments that stood out.
The journey begins with Matt Dinniman’s *Dungeon Crawler Carl*, but the mission is bigger: honest conversations about the fantasy stories they love, plenty of questionable opinions, and enough friendly disagreement to keep the bad takes coming.

title: Lucid Dreaming for Everyone
author: Henrik Holmer
description:
Welcome to Lucid Dreaming for Everyone!
This project is about spreading knowledge about lucid dreaming and is based on the book with the same name, by Henrik Holmer.
Lucid dreaming means knowing you're dreaming while still in the dream. It's a skill anyone can learn, and my goal is to show you how.
The series is designed to be followed from the beginning, but each episode also focuses on a specific topic, so you can find what interests you at the moment.
Also available as a video series on YouTube.
www.luciddreamingforeveryone.com

title: The Game They Played
author: Bernie Corbett
description:
Hockey careers end. The stories don't.
The Game They Played is a hockey interview podcast from Bernie Corbett, the play-by-play voice of Boston University men's hockey for more than forty years and host of SiriusXM NHL Radio's Hockey On Campus.
Each week Bernie sits down with the NHL greats who played the game: Stanley Cup champions, Hockey Hall of Famers, Olympians, and the players whose names still carry weight in rinks across New England and beyond. The conversation runs the whole arc. Where the dream began. The road to the NHL. The games, teammates, and moments that defined a career. The obstacles nobody saw. And then the harder chapter: leaving the game, and building a life after it.
This is not a highlight recap. It is the long conversation NHL players rarely get to have about their own lives, with a host who has covered the game for four decades and knows the questions worth asking.
The game was one chapter. The story continued.
New episodes weekly, in video and audio. www.thegametheyplayed.com

title: Golden Whispers
author: Özge Özçopur
description: Stories from a heart on its way home.

title: Сумасшедшая (Deluxe 2026)
author: Marios Bairas Alexey Sparrow
description: Marios Bairas Alexey Sparrow

title: Sustainable Conversations
author: Sustainable Development Conversations Initiative
description:
The Sustainable Conversations is a podcast by the Sustainable Development Conversations Initiative (SDCI), exploring the intersection of everyday experiences, public policy, governance, and sustainable development.
Through grassroots stories and expert perspectives, we unpack the issues shaping our communities, examine the policies affecting our lives, and explore practical pathways towards meaningful change.

title: Reimagining RSE
author: Reimagining RSE
description:
At Reimagining RSE, we believe that good education is not about providing simple answers to complex questions. Instead, it is about creating spaces where curiosity, critical thinking and dialogue can flourish.
Dr Emily Setty, Associate Professor in Criminology at the University of Surrey, and Jonny Hunt, Senior Lecturer in Childhood and Youth Studies at the University of Bedfordshire, are joined by educators, researchers and practitioners to explore how we can do relationships and sex education better.

title: Centered Cybersecurity (EN)
author: Dirk De Nijs
description: Clear perspectives on cybersecurity, governance and audit.

title: Main Characters
author: Main Characters
description:
Main Characters is a podcast hosted by Kayla Parrilla and Derick “DA” Adames, built around honest conversations about life, business, relationships, personal growth, and everything that comes with figuring it out along the way.


Each episode brings real experiences, different perspectives, and conversations that go beyond what you see on social media. From building businesses and navigating relationships to success, setbacks, and the lessons learned in between, Kayla and DA keep it open and real.


Because everyone has a story. This is ours.


Welcome to Main Characters.

title: Morgan Moves Differently
author: Morgan Key
description:
Morgan Moves Differently is a podcast about navigating life a little differently—and finding plenty to laugh about along the way.
I’m Morgan: a wife, mom, wheelchair user, and someone living with hereditary spastic paraplegia and the lasting effects of bilateral hip replacements due to Perthes.
Here, I’m talking about the parts of disability that don’t always make it into the highlight reel: the grief, the frustration, the tiny victories, motherhood, mobility, adapting to a body that doesn’t always cooperate, and learning to build a life that works for me.
It’s honest, sometimes emotional, occasionally chaotic, and always sprinkled with a little humor—because disability is a huge part of my life, but it isn’t the only part of me.
This is Morgan Moves Differently—real life, just from a different perspective.

title: Uncomfortable Conversations
author: Kdonic
description: An online discussion platform that was created in May 2020 after the killing of George Flyod. . It became a space for strangers to have uncomfortable conversations, and discuss taboos within the black community.

title: Parks Are Calling Podcast
author: Henry Wilder
description:
Every park had to be argued for. Somebody noticed it, somebody fought for it, and it is open today because that fight was won.

Each episode takes one park and tells the sourced story of why it exists, what that fight left behind, and why you would go stand in it. All 63 national parks, then the state parks people ask about most.

Hosted by Henry Wilder of Miles of Quiet, out of Bend, Oregon. When he has been somewhere, he will tell you. When he has not, he says so.

Presented by Verdant Traveler (verdanttraveler.com).

title: Midnight Archive
author: KG Heath
description:
Story anthology podcast, featuring indie and trad-pub authors. 
Door closed, lights off, and your torch on. This… is Midnight Archive.

title: The Dumonted Pod
author: Rick Dumont
description: Award winning journalist, actor and filmmaker Rick Dumont brings a deep curiosity to how fellow humans are making their way through this life, a strong positive energy, frivolity and compassionate sensitivity in his conversations. This podcast features discussions with some of the most inspirational and fascinating people as we explore the human condition. Who we are, where we are going and what we've experienced along the way. From the arts to mysticism, spirituality, social issues and more, the conversations with guests can go pretty much anywhere, and usually does.

title: Cultured Voices
author: Dr Fatima
description:
This podcast is a space for deep, honest, and uplifting conversations rooted in faith, culture, and the shared need for growth. In each episode, we dive into stories and lessons that inspire us to live with purpose and authenticity. 


From motherhood and identity to wellness, mindset, and community, every episode is designed to spark reflection and connection. 

The podcast highlights Somali and Muslim voices, while also sharing universal lessons that anyone can relate to. 


It’s more than just a podcast, t’s a place to feel seen, to learn, and to be reminded that we grow stronger when we walk this journey together.

title: The Side Door with Braden Owen
author: Braden Owen
description:
You don't need permission to lead. You need proximity to people who already have.
The Side Door is real, unfiltered conversations with founders and operators who've actually built something, hosted by Braden Owen. No polished takeaways, no recycled advice. Just the rooms most people never get into.
If you're driven, hungry, and done waiting for someone to hand you a seat, this is your side door in.
New episodes regularly. Runway Media Co.

title: Three Takes on AI
author: Brian, Campbell and Michael
description:
Three Takes on AI cuts through the hype with real conversations about artificial intelligence in business.
Your Hosts: 
Brian Silverman (ABSAI Consulting) - Tech perspective 
Mike Muhlfelder (Calm Ocean Sales) - Real-world implementation
Campbell Robertson (Boxwood Strategy Group) - Business strategy
We actually read the studies and test the tools while others recycle headlines. 
Each episode tackles questions keeping leaders up at night: 
Is AI delivering ROI? How do you govern Shadow AI? What’s hype vs. reality?

title: Halftime Hearsay
author: Halftime Hearsay
description: Two guys, zero filters, and whatever's on their minds. One episode it's a hot take on last night's game, the next it's a deep dive into something completely unrelated, and somehow it always circles back to real talk about life. No script, no agenda, just sports, stories, and the kind of conversation you'd have with your buddy at halftime... if halftime lasted an hour.

title: The Natural Womanhood Podcast
author: Natural Womanhood
description: The Natural Womanhood Podcast brings together experts in the field of fertility awareness for candid, informative, and friendly conversations about authentic women's health. From pelvic floor physical therapy, to surgical interventions, to relationships and mental health, no topic is off limits as we seek to bring the empowering truth about women, their bodies, and their cycles to our listeners: that is, that women's cycles are essential, powerful, beautiful, and do not need to be "controlled." The Natural Womanhood podcast is hosted by Grace Emily Stark, Natural Womanhood's Editor-in-Chief. Grace is an award-winning journalist, a certified instructor of the Sympto-Thermal Method of fertility awareness, and she holds a M.A. in Bioethics and Health Policy. The Natural Womanhood Podcast is a production of Natural Womanhood, a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving women's health literacy through the promotion of evidence-based fertility awareness methods (FAMs) of natural family planning. description:
TEMPERED BY TRUTH

Life has a way of putting all of us through the fire.

Marriage. Family. Work. Relationships. Temptation. Failure. Anxiety. Grief. Questions about faith. Questions about purpose. And those moments when life simply doesn't go according to plan.

Tempered by Truth is a Christian podcast for adults who want to navigate real life through the truth and wisdom of God's Word.

This isn't about pretending Christians have everything figured out. We don't. It's about opening Scripture, asking difficult questions and discovering how biblical truth applies when Monday morning arrives and real life begins.

Each episode explores subjects that matter: faith, marriage, family, relationships, leadership, work, integrity, forgiveness, temptation, stress, grief, spiritual warfare, purpose, personal responsibility and leaving a legacy that matters.

Like steel being tempered by fire, our character is often shaped through pressure, adversity and testing. The difficult seasons of life can become places where faith grows deeper, character becomes stronger and we learn what it really means to trust God.

Tempered by Truth combines biblical teaching with honest conversation and practical application you can carry into everyday life.

No pretending. No empty motivational slogans. Just honest questions, biblical truth and a desire to become more faithful followers of Jesus Christ.

Faith tested. Character forged. Lives transformed by truth.

Welcome to Tempered by Truth.

description: Tyler hosts a variety of guests with interviews on sports  &  strategy; construction  &  design; sustainability  &  society; finance  &  policy; and technology  &  ethics. With dozens of episodes, we blend careful research with a dash of attic‑level humor (ceiling jokes included). Tune in for insights that inform and inspire. Pull up a chair, let’s get slanted!

title: Story in Between: Spanish Listening
author: Story in Between
description:
**Learn Spanish through short stories, listening practice, vocabulary, and active recall.** Story in Between uses a Listen → Learn → Recall → Return method to help you understand spoken Spanish naturally and remember what you hear.
🎧 **HOW TO PRACTICE**
1. Hear the story naturally in Spanish.
2. Connect each Spanish phrase with its English meaning.
3. Recall the Spanish before the reveal.
4. Return to the story and test your understanding.

title: The Phantom Podcast
author: Bobby Benjamin and Zoe Linton
description: The Phantom has entered the podcast studio—and Zoe is here to keep him grounded. The Phantom Podcast mixes absurd comedy, playful takes on podcast culture, and candid conversations with creative guests. Come for the masks and questionable Phantom behavior; stay for the stories, surprises, and genuine connection underneath it all.

title: Heal, Build and Become
author: Maris
description:
Heal. Build. Become. is a space for honest conversations about healing, ambition, and personal growth.
We explore mental health, therapy, trauma, divorce, wellness, mindset, business, leadership, entrepreneurship, and women empowerment through real stories and meaningful conversations with founders, leaders, experts, and inspiring women.
Heal what hurt you. Build what matters. Become who you’re meant to be.

title: Beziehungsduell mit Gast
author: TVfriends
description: Eigentlich sind Babsi und Titus Kollegin und Kollege und seit Jahren ein eingespieltes Team. Doch beim Thema Beziehung könnten ihre Welten kaum weiter auseinanderliegen: Sie ist Single und vogelfrei, er Vater einer Großfamilie. Was erwarten wir von Liebe und vom Leben? Braucht Glück eine Beziehung – oder gerade nicht? Und wer von beiden ist eigentlich glücklicher? Dazu kommt in jeder Folge ein prominenter Gast, der noch einmal ganz andere Erfahrungen und Sichtweisen in die Melange wirft. Das Ergebnis: ein heiteres, ehrliches und manchmal überraschendes Gespräch über Liebe, Beziehungen und all die Dos and Don’ts dazwischen.

title: MEN/TORS
author: Dean and David Curry
description: MEN/TORS is a podcast for men carrying real weight — marriage, fatherhood, work, leadership, pressure, purpose, and failure. Hosted by twin brothers Dean Curry and Dr. David Curry, the show brings honest brotherhood, mentorship, and hard-earned wisdom to the table. Each episode tackles one real struggle men face and asks what it costs to lead without guidance — and what changes when a man has someone older, wiser, and honest enough to tell him the truth. Built for men who want to lead well, live with purpose, and mentor the next man behind them. No fluff. Real talk, brother to brother.

title: Crystal Clear: An AI Leadership Podcast
author: Crystal King
description:
We all know AI is changing the way we work. But what is it doing to our originality, our judgment, and our ability to connect?

I’m Crystal King, Senior AI Evangelist at HubSpot Academy, and this is Crystal Clear—a podcast for business leaders who want to lead the AI transition, not just survive it.

We are stepping away from the endless noise of "new prompts and tools" to focus on the human side of AI adoption. Together with researchers, practitioners, and industry experts, we’re figuring out how to safeguard your brand’s voice, build highly capable teams, and seamlessly blend human intuition with AI efficiency.

If you’re a marketer or salesperson who believes that scaling a business shouldn't mean sacrificing the human touch, you’re in the right place. Let's get to work.

title: BeyondReach
author: Ilerioluwase
description:
The intersection of ambition and reality. Hosted by Ilerioluwase, BeyondReach explores the silent cost of ambition, the struggle of the 'academic trench,' and the strategies we use to build a future while surviving the present. 
This is for the students, the builders, and the dreamers striving for more while managing the now.

description: It's about Books, music, weather, etc.

True crime tells you what happened.  We explore Why.
