title: Wookiees & Wolves
author: Wookiees & Wolves
description: Wookiees & Wolves is a podcast from two best friends talking Star Wars and Wolves hoops — with plenty of hot takes, debates, and fan overreactions along the way.

title: The Blogle Boys
author: War Blogle
description:
War Blogle and his two teenage sons talk Auburn, sports, and whatever else comes up. Three Auburn homers, two generations, and plenty of opinions nobody asked for. 
A War Blogle Network podcast.
© WarBlogle.com 2026

title: The Extraordinary Wisdom Podcast
author: extraordinarylifecoachLoretta
description: Extraordinary Wisdom with coach/mentor Loretta is a faith filled podcast offering biblical wisdom, spiritual insight, encouragement, and practical guidance for everyday life. Through conversations, Loretta helps listeners navigate life's seasons, grow their faith, discover purpose, and apply extraordinary wisdom to ordinary situations!

title: The Newsboy Partners (Adventures in Friendship and Teamwork)
author: Frank V. Webster
description:
Thirteen-year-old Jimmy and his best friend, Tommy, dive into the bustling world of newspaper selling, but their excitement quickly turns into a high-stakes adventure. When they discover a plot to undermine their local paper, the boys must navigate the tricky waters of loyalty, friendship, and courage. As they investigate, they unravel secrets that could change their lives and their community forever.

In "The Newsboy Partners," Frank V. Webster captures the thrill of youth and the weight of responsibility. Readers will connect with Jimmy and Tommy as they face not only the challenges of selling newspapers but also the moral dilemmas that come with their newfound knowledge. The story explores themes of integrity, teamwork, and the importance of standing up for what’s right.

Will the boys outsmart the forces threatening their town? Can their friendship withstand the pressure of their daring escapades? Join Jimmy and Tommy on a journey filled with unexpected twists, heart-pounding moments, and valuable lessons about the power of friendship and the impact of one voice in a bustling world. Perfect for young listeners eager for a tale of adventure and intrigue, this audiobook invites you to rediscover the joy of childhood and the thrill of uncovering the truth. Get ready to cheer for the underdogs as they fight for their community and their dreams!

title: The Dee Show Podcast
author: Dee Summers
description: Hello Deelicious Deevas! This is quite literally just a journal for my most random rants and raves. Each week (or so) I’ll be talking about whatever I want to and it’s your choice to tune in to the topic!!

title: Around The Post Podcast
author: Michael Eagleson
description: Thie Podcast talks about all things Pickleball.

title: Cobden Conversations
author: Cobden Primary School
description:
Welcome to Cobden Conversations! This is our very own podcast, planned and created by students at Cobden Primary School as part of the Student Leaders Congress project.

In each episode, we get to sit down with people from our Cobden community and ask them about their lives. We especially want to know how they look after their mental health and wellbeing, and what advice they have for kids like us.

Our goal is to share stories, learn new ideas, and give other kids some helpful tips for staying happy and healthy. Plus, we get to practise awesome skills like interviewing, recording, and podcasting!

title: UNPAUSED
author: Sam Anderson
description: Unpaused is an honest, no-filter podcast about perimenopause, andropause, relationships and everyday life at home and at work. Hosted by Sam Anderson, lecturer, firefighter, author and speaker, alongside neuroscience and psychology coach Renée LeBlanc. Each 30-minute episode explores real-world experiences, challenges and conversations that often go wrong. No medical waffle. No pretending it's easy. Just plain language, humour, the occasional swear word, and practical understanding. Because it's not you versus them. It's you both versus the problem.

title: Cancel Out The Noise
author: Tess de Wolf
description: Get out of your head. Follow through.

title: Stories. Songs. Seasons.
author: Tom Shiels
description:
We’re all made of stories, but they’re not always profound. It’s something your grandad told you. A song that takes you back to a road trip. The smell of smoke in the air in autumn or a saying that still pops into your head at the strangest times. Often, the smallest moments are where memories are made. 
In Stories. Songs. Seasons. the podcast, writer Tom Shiels sits down with a new guest every episode to talk about three stories that have shaped them, three songs that have moved them. And the season which most feels like home.

title: Smoke rings
author: Smoke Rings
description: Audio crime thriller, no narration, we let your ears provide the visuals as you follow Emerson try to build a life in Atlanta after leaving Chicago four years prior. Meanwhile in Chicago Jacoby and his right hand man M-Bone are thr type of people that don't flee anything. Listen as these two cities unify under one crown. All original songs on the soundtrack

title: TU Update from Oklahoma's Own
author: Griffin Media
description: TU Update from Oklahoma’s Own is your source for the latest on Tulsa Golden Hurricane football.  The News On 6 sports team breaks down the biggest stories surrounding TU, with analysis of each game, the latest from inside the program and a look ahead at what’s next for the Golden Hurricane.  From weekly matchups and player performances to the direction of the program under head coach Tre Lamb, TU Update takes you beyond the headlines with insight, reaction and conversations surrounding Tulsa football.  New episodes throughout the season from Oklahoma’s Own News On 6.

title: Unfinished Leaders
author: W. P. Carey Executive Education
description:
Some of the most important lessons in our careers are the ones no one could have taught us beforehand.
Unfinished Leaders brings together leaders, executives, entrepreneurs, and experts to share the experiences that shaped how they think, work, and lead.
Each episode begins with a story - a challenge, a failure, an unexpected turn, a difficult decision, or a moment that changed everything. From there, we go beyond what happened to explore what was learned, how it changed the person behind the title, and what others can take away from that experience.
Because learning doesn't stop at graduation

title: Mid-Valley News
author: Mid-Valley
description: The latest local news from MidValleyRadio.com

title: by Humans for Humans
author: gabiru
description:
by humans for humans is a conversation for those who care about meaning.
On analog tape. Uncut. Unedited.
We live in a time of endless noise.
Everything looks perfect, but nothing feels real.
We scroll through polished lives, manufactured stories, and recycled ideas -
and somewhere along the way, we forgot what it means to feel something.
This is a call to return to what’s real.
To remember that creativity was never meant to impress - 
it was meant to connect.
That behind every song, film, campaign or frame - 
there’s a heartbeat.
We’re not here to be louder.
We’re here to be realer.

title: YesTalk
author: First Hawaiian Bank
description:
Real conversations. Local perspectives. Financial confidence.


YesTalk is First Hawaiian Bank’s official podcast featuring authentic conversations with leaders, subject matter experts, employees, and community partners on topics that matter, from financial wellness and education to leadership, innovation, and community impact. 


Deposit products offered by First Hawaiian Bank, Member FDIC Equal Housing Lender

title: Only Done Right
author: Dodge Labs
description: Only Done Right is the audio version of the Dodge Labs newsletter — short essays on digital transformation for financial services, enterprise nonprofits, and professional services. Redesign the work before you automate it. Hosted by Roger Mitchell.

title: That Said with Talia Schlanger
author: Talia Schlanger, SiriusXM
description:
Welcome to a show that doesn’t skim the surface. That Said with Talia Schlanger is where intelligence and curiosity meet great conversation. Join us for in-depth interviews with artists, celebrities and public figures about their work, their life and the ideas shaping how they see the world. 
Plus, there’s Article Club: a thoughtful deep dive into a must-read piece of writing, unpacking the cultural conversation behind it all. 
That Said is an invitation to slow down, think deeply and spend time with ideas that stick.

title: Becoming, Not Performing
author: Lem Usita
description: A show about the identity everyone is quietly building, and what gets in the way of it. Lem Usita, Ed.D., talks with therapists, parents, and his own family about screens, performance, and what it actually takes for a person, teenager or adult, to become someone real. New conversations weekly.

title: Being Poly
author: beingpoly
description:
What does it really look like to live authentically?

Being Poly is a podcast about identity, authenticity, connection, and purpose—hosted by husband and wife Ana Aiono Dowden and Greg Dowden.

“Poly” has more than one meaning for us. It’s rooted in our Polynesian/Pasifika identity, our experience with polyamory, and the many layers that make us who we are.

Through honest conversations, personal stories, and plenty of laughter, we explore relationships, sexuality, culture, family, love, and what happens when you start questioning the rules you inherited and intentionally build a life that actually fits you.

We’re not here to tell anyone the “right” way to live or love. We’re sharing what we’ve learned—and are still learning—as we figure out what it means to show up fully and authentically as ourselves.

Because there’s more than one way to love, more than one way to build a family, and more than one way to be you.

Being Poly is an Island Hotwife Media production.

www.beingpoly.com

www.islandhotwife.com

title: Something to Give
author: Jackson Fox
description: Everyone has something to offer the world, especially in terms of their own experience, strength and hope. This is a podcast where I sit down with people and talk about their life and really anything that they are passionate about and I believe listeners can glean something from every conversation and relate in their own unique way!

title: Memoirs of the Unheard
author: Memoirs of the Unheard
description:
Memoirs of the Unheard shares the everyday stories the world too often overlooks — moments of struggle, resilience, and hope from people rarely given a platform.
Because some voices should never remain silent, and every story deserves to be heard.

title: Inside the OR
author: Max Feinstein
description: Hear the stories of the people who work in operating rooms

title: The Stargazer | The Prequel Limited Series
author: Lean Into Love Productions
description:
The Stargazer is a cinematic, short-form science-fiction horror audio drama and fiction podcast featuring a full voice cast, immersive sound design, original music, and a serialized story spanning the galaxy.

The series follows Commander Charlie Bennett, Avery Maxwell, and the original Stargazer crew as they embark on a dangerous journey across the stars. What begins as a mission of exploration soon becomes something much greater, setting into motion the mysterious events that will eventually lead to The Stargazer Initiative.

As the crew travels deeper into the unknown, they encounter strange worlds, unexpected dangers, and mysteries that challenge everything they believe about the universe—and one another. Every discovery brings them closer to a darkness that has been waiting among the stars.

This is where the story begins.

Will you follow the Stargazers into the dark?

title: Conversations from the Coast: The Podcast
author: UCF Coastal (UCF Center for Integrated Coastal Research)
description: The future of our coasts matters to all of us. Coasts are where land meets ocean, but also where people, nature, communities, and economies come together. They are vital to our way of life, especially here in Florida, from our beaches, wetlands, and estuaries to the communities they support. Yet they face growing challenges from sea-level rise, storms, erosion, pollution, and development. That's why we created this podcast. Join UCF Coastal Director Ivan Haigh and Dr. Gabi Quadrado for conversations with researchers, practitioners, and community leaders working to build a more resilient future

title: Long Distance Bestie
author: Bhavna Singh
description: A podcast for the besties who live far away but still know everything. Unhinged stories, friendship lore, dating debriefs, and 3-hour catch-up calls.

title: One More Tab
author: One More Tab Productions
description: What do a saturation diver, a political scandal, and a man who's never slept more than two hours have in common? Nothing, except that Avi, Saijal, and Anchita went down all three rabbit holes anyway. One More Tab is a weekly dive into whatever's open in their browser, unhinged tangents included.

title: Wonders of Arizona
author: Charles Tyrie
description: Seven episodes, seven wonders, one unbelievable road trip

title: La vida no es Ligth
author: Jazmín Larissa López
description: Vivimos en la era de lo rápido y lo cómodo, pero ¿a qué costo? Inspirado en la obra El hombre light de Enrique Rojas, este podcast explora las consecuencias de una sociedad vacía de compromiso, esfuerzo y convicciones. Aquí desarmamos la apatía moderna para volver a conectar con el desarrollo personal auténtico, el criterio propio y la proyección social. Un podcast para quienes se niegan a vivir en piloto automático.

title: Elders Uniting the World.
author: Tom
description: Elders Uniting the World connects the wisdom of elders with the energy of younger generations. Each episode looks at real life through the lens of the Seven Generations principle — judging companies, leaders, and choices by their actions, not their words. Hosted by someone with 30+ years in tech and a lifetime of lessons learned the hard way.

title: These 2 Shouldn't Have A Podcast
author: Paul Macleod & Karl Sandland
description:
Ever wondered what happens when two mates get microphones and absolutely no supervision? Neither did we.


Welcome to 'These 2 Shouldn't Have a Podcast' with Paul Macleod and Karl Sandland — where each episode starts with one topic and somehow ends up somewhere completely different.


We talk about all sorts of random stuff. Sometimes we agree, sometimes we don't, but we always take the p*ss out of each other, and ourselves.


Unplanned. Unfiltered. Stories. Dodgy opinions. Laughs and the occasional bit of accidental wisdom.


If you're easily confused, you probably won't get it.


If you're up for a bit of random sh*t...and a laugh - listen in!

title: Your Smart Friend
author: Orane Jones
description: This podcast is all about technology, some tips on how to fix and optimize your tech recommendations on what tech to buy, general updates on news about the consumer electronics industry

title: The Move In Senior Living Marketing
author: Unlock Health
description:
Welcome to The Move In Senior Living Marketing, a podcast from Unlock Health, a full-service marketing partner for the aging services industry. 
Join us for candid conversations exploring the latest marketing strategies with the senior living community leaders, and innovative solution partners, who are moving our industry forward. 
Together we’ll build a community to build better communities. Welcome to The Move In Senior Living Marketing, with Larry Williams.

title: Therapy Fridays
author: Kennedy Gresham
description: A safe space for young women to talk freely and explore different conversations to help them plant their feet on the ground. To simply maneuver in the world to the best of their ability. A space to be seen, see, and grow with women around you during your process.

title: College Football with Stugotz & The Bear
author: iHeartPodcasts
description:
College football is better with Stugotz and The Bear. Jon “Stugotz” Weiner and college football analyst and sports betting expert Chris “The Bear” Fallica tackle the biggest games, stories and debates while celebrating everything that makes college football great, from legendary rivalries and iconic venues to game-day traditions, tailgates and unforgettable moments.
Stugotz brings the passion, opinions and questionable logic. The Bear brings the expertise, analysis and betting perspective to keep him in line. Follow College Football with Stugotz & The Bear and join them every Monday and Friday throughout the college football season.

title: Choose Your Line
author: Wendy Cary
description: In racing, the best line through a turn isn't the most aggressive one, it's the one that leaves you best positioned for what comes next. Work asks for the same judgment. Choose Your Line, hosted by Wendy Cary, takes one real situation each episode, a hard conversation, a big opportunity, a role that's outgrown itself, and works through what's actually happening, so you choose your line instead of just reacting to it.

title: Talent Economics
author: Vidal Ferreira | Achim von Brunn
description:
Most workforce conversations happen in HR language. The money gets decided in business language.
Talent Economics translates. Vidal Ferreira (The Workforce Strategist) and Achim von Brunn (The Talent Economist) take one big workforce shift - AI, skills, restructuring, demographics - and turn it into what leaders actually manage: cost, risk, productivity and return.
Built for CHROs, executives, strategy and transformation leaders who need commercial clarity, not HR fluff.
Where talent decisions meet business impact. Smart talk. Real impact.

title: Yaaay Sports Podcast
author: Yaaay Sports Podcast
description: We watch the game, but we're here for everything else!

title: Blitz&Bantr
author: Blitz&Bantr
description: Three friends, a lot of football, and probably way too many opinions. Welcome to Blitz&Bantr!

title: Wait... Why Do We Do That?
author: Steven
description:
Have you ever stopped in the middle of something completely normal and thought... wait, why do we do that?

Why is the workday eight hours? Why do we change the clocks twice a year? Why is a marathon exactly 26.2 miles? Why do hotels want you out by 11? Why do we tip? And who decided everyone needed a lawn?

Wait... Why Do We Do That? explores the strange, surprising and sometimes ridiculous stories behind the everyday things we rarely stop to question.

Each episode takes one ordinary part of modern life and follows the story of how it got here, who decided it, why it stuck and whether the original reason still makes any sense today.

It's history, psychology, business, culture and a healthy dose of curiosity, without the lecture.

Because apparently, there's a reason for almost everything.

Even if it isn't a particularly good one.

title: Fembots
author: Emma Rogers
description: A podcast about the intersection women and technology or more accurately technology's ongoing attempt to improving women by removing parts where we speak.

title: The Palestinian and the Jew Podcast
author: The Palestinian and the Jew Podcast
description:
Two best friends: one Palestinian, one Jew. How the heck did that happen?
On this show, politics is sitting this one out. Instead, we’re talking love, dating, relationships, money, culture, friendship, fashion, family — and all the things you’re probably not supposed to say out loud… definitely not on a podcast!
We’ll disagree, laugh, overshare, change our minds and probably ask, “Should we really be putting this out there?”
Welcome to The Palestinian and the Jew — you’ve got a seat at our table.

title: Fairview Baptist Church Seminars
author: Fairview Baptist Church
description: Teaching, seminars, and conference messages from Fairview Baptist Church in Calgary, Alberta. Find out more at www.fairviewbaptistchurch.ca

title: Living Water Baptist Church
author: One Soul at a Time
description: King James Bible Preaching services from Living Water Baptist Church in Mocksville, North Carolina. Pastor Zach Vernon preaches and teaches on a variety of topics. Visit our ministry website Onesoulatatime.net/livingwaterbaptist

title: Fellowship Church Men’s Podcast
author: fellowshipmenspodcast
description: This podcast is for the Fellowship Men's Study, to build men up in their faith and to direct them to the truth of God's Word as they grow in community together. Attend the weekly Men's Study on Monday nights, 6-9PM at Fellowship Church.

title: Ebenezer Chapel Church History Classes
author: Ebenezer Chapel
description:
A look back at the amazing 2000 year history of the Church. Topics to be covered weekly, include the following.
1. Why study Church History?
2. The birth, growth and formation of the Apostolic Church (A survey of the NT book of Acts)
3. The Persecuted Church (Justin Martyr responds)
4. Christianity and the Roman Empire (The Arian controversy, Nicea, Constantine)
5. St. Augustine of Hippo
6. The Medieval Church (The Papacy, Anselm of Canterbury, St. Bernard of Clairvaux)
7. The Protestant Reformation brewing (John Wycliffe, John Hus) 
....

title: K-Defence
author: The International Institute for Strategic Studies (IISS)
description:
The IISS podcast K-Defence explores South Korea’s evolving role in regional and global security, with a focus on its defence industry, defence innovation and defence cooperation with international partners. 


The monthly podcast is hosted by Dr Lami Kim, IISS Korea Chair in Advanced Technologies, National Security and Defence, and produced by the IISS in London.  


For more information, please visit https://www.iiss.org/. 


For more information on the IISS Korea Chair, please visit IISS Korea Chair in Advanced Technologies, National Security and Defence 

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: WELL/BEING
author: THE WELL
description:
Let’s be honest: the wellness world feels overwhelming. The trends are trending, the quick fixes are fake, and the noise feels deafening. WELL/BEING is here to help with that. 

WELL/BEING is a podcast from THE WELL — the global community for living better.  These are short, honest conversations about what it actually feels like to navigate your body, your work, your relationships and your life. Each episode explores real-world questions with experts, tapping into lived experiences and imperfect perspectives. Some conversations will challenge the way you think, others will help you slow down, tune in or simply feel less alone. 

Because wellness isn’t something to perfect — it’s how we live every day.

title: EV Powered: Plugged In
author: EV Powered
description: Plugged In is the long-form electric car podcast from EV Powered, the UK's leading EV magazine, and the Everything EV podcast team. We sit down with the founders, engineers and executives driving the electric car industry to hear their stories and where they think EVs go next. We also run deep dives into the subjects that matter to EV drivers. For weekly EV news, listen to Everything EV and visit evpowered.co.uk.

title: RE:claiming Church
author: Charissa Howe & Alan Olson
description: Are you a former or active churchgoer or clergy member worn down by the state of the church? Welcome to RE:claiming Church. Hosted by two progressive mainline pastors and friends of 15 years, this podcast moves past talking heads to help our communities get "unstuck" from outdated models. We aren't looking to return to the past—we are here to reclaim the church from being hijacked, restore civil discourse, and build new spiritual structures. Join us to find a better story about Christians in America, and leave every episode feeling hopeful, energized, and connected.

title: Chewing the Cud with the Mik
author: Entre Media
description:
Welcome to Chewing the Cud with the Mik! 

Flatonia Livestock Commission Company's very own podcast dedicated to bringing you this week's livestock market news and updates. Tune in weekly to hear about Monday's sale and catch up with Mik and his guests. 

Be sure to follow us on Facebook:

https://www.facebook.com/flatonialivestock

title: Anion Identification
author: VSigmaBond Chemistry
description:
Anion Identification is an audio revision series from VSigmaBond Chemistry, featuring key chemistry concepts, tests, observations, reactions, and important points related to anion identification. Designed to help students quickly revise and remember essential chemistry content anytime, anywhere. This series is part of the chemistry learning program by Dr. Vajira Seneviratne.
Credits
Voice & Audio Production: Nabiha Nayeem & Buddhiprabha Rathnayake

title: WESTERN CANADIAN HOCKEY PODCAST (WCHP)
author: Jon Fuller & Joe Proulx
description: The Western Canadian Hockey Podcast (aka the WCHP) (aka the Sea Lion Podcast) is a sports podcast hosted by Jon Fuller and Joe Proulx where they yap about whatever they want to and give their thoughts on everything related to the 4 NHL teams based in Western Canada (Vancouver Canucks, Calgary Flames, Edmonton Oilers, Winnipeg Jets) as two Winnipeggers that seek to give these teams the coverage (and subsequent praise or slander) they deserve.

title: The Sign-In Table
author: Matt Angerer
description: The Sign-In Table is a podcast from VolunteerBadge where host Matt Angerer sits down with the leaders of camps, churches, homeschool co-ops and community nonprofits to hear their mission, why they started, the difference they're making and how others can help. New conversations every other week.

title: Rhythm and Rhymes
author: Rhythm and Rhymes
description:
Rhythm & Rhymes is your global hub for all black music.
From discussing new releases and trends to exploring the business side of music, we provide dynamic & enlightening perspectives.

Hosted by Tristan Rogers (CEO, Huq) and Denise, Site Unseen takes you inside unfiltered conversations about gut instinct versus data, the sites that surprised everyone, and the hard lessons learned along the way.
Each episode follows one location story end-to-end - The Find, The Call, Opening Day, and The Verdict - anchored by one signature question: Why here… and would you do it again?

title: Single Mom Faith Reset | Faith, Divorce, Overwhelmed Single Parent, How to Trust in God
author: Katherine Sullivan
description:
Did divorce leave you feeling like you failed your family? Or like you failed God? 
Maybe you lie awake wondering if you ruined your children’s future. Maybe guilt follows you everywhere. Maybe you feel lonely, overwhelmed, and unsure how to rebuild your life as a single mom. Maybe you feel like no one truly understands what you’ve been through or feel as though no one in your friend circle can relate to you.
And maybe the hardest question you face is this:
After everything that’s happened, would God even want me back?
If those thoughts sound familiar, take a deep breath. You’re not alone anymore.
Single Mom Faith Reset is a Christian podcast for single moms who want to rebuild their lives, restore their faith, and rediscover who they are in Christ after divorce.
Inside this podcast, you’ll find faith-filled encouragement for single moms, honest conversations about motherhood after divorce, Biblical mindset shifts that replace guilt, shame, and fear, practical ways to grow closer to God again, and reminders of your true identity in Christ.
This show is here to help you reconnect with God, rebuild your confidence, and create a peaceful, faith-centered life for you and your children.
Hey, I’m Katherine. I’m a single mom, book lover, and hopefully your new friend.
When my marriage ended, I tried to carry everything alone. I didn’t want to burden anyone, so I pushed my feelings down and tried to hold life together with sheer willpower. I was juggling motherhood, work, loneliness, and heartbreak while pretending everything was fine. 
But inside, I had hit rock bottom.
Eventually I realized something had to change. I couldn’t keep doing life my way and expect things to get better, especially spiritually.
So, like the prodigal son, I ran back to God.
I started praying again. I opened my Bible again. I walked back into church again.
And slowly, hope began to return.
What I discovered surprised me most: God hadn’t rejected me. He had been waiting for me to come back to Him the entire time.
This podcast shares the faith, lessons, encouragement, and real-life moments from that journey, because if you’re walking through divorce, guilt, loneliness, or starting over, you deserve support and hope too.
Your story isn’t over. God is still writing something beautiful.
So grab your coffee, cozy up with your favorite blanket, and find a quiet place to listen.
Let’s rebuild your life with God one step at a time.

description: What if the stories we believe could change the way we see the world? Welcome to The Belief Files, a podcast exploring the strange, fascinating, and sometimes unsettling power of myths, cultural beliefs, legends, and cults. From mysterious places and ancient traditions to modern day mysteries, each episode uncovers the stories behind the belief and asks one question: how much do our beliefs really control us?

title: Living in Spain
author: David Wright
description:
Living in Spain with David Wright
Thinking about moving to Spain, living in Spain, working in Spain or starting a new life in the Spanish sunshine?
Welcome to Living in Spain with David Wright, a podcast based on real-life experience rather than theory.I’m David Wright, an Englishman who moved to Almería, Spain, 24 years ago. Since then, I’ve built a life here, worked in Spain, run businesses, bought property and helped many other people understand what it really takes to make the move and settle successfully in Spain.Over the years, my experiences have also taken me into the media. I’ve appeared as a guest on BBC television, including BBC News, and have also appeared on A Place in the Sun. I went on to become a radio presenter in Spain, hosting my own live English-language radio shows, interviewing guests and discussing life in Spain, local news and the issues that matter to British expats.

On Living in Spain, I share what I’ve learned from more than two decades of actually living here. We’ll talk about moving from the UK to Spain, Spanish residency, visas, property, healthcare, working in Spain, earning an income, retirement, Spanish culture, the cost of living, bureaucracy and everyday expat life.I’ll also share my own experiences—the good, the bad and the things I wish I had known when I first arrived. You’ll hear conversations with people who live and work in Spain, experts who can help with the more complicated aspects of Spanish life, and stories from people who have already made the move.Whether you’re planning to retire to Spain, looking for ways to work in Spain, buying a Spanish property, considering moving your family here, or simply dreaming about a different lifestyle, this podcast is designed to give you practical information from someone who has been there and done it.24 years in Spain.
 Real experience. Real stories. Real life in Spain.

Find more free information, guides and advice on my main website:www.davidwrightonline.com
